baseline_physics.initial_pool: singletons plus replayed previous-k sequence subset

interpretation: No current-k solution used as a seed.
Equal selected parent sequence counts; audit actual replay acceptance and child additions separately.
Derived seed artifacts are not CG endpoints and carry no pricing certificate.
Parent CG and MIP cost is retained and must be included in end-to-end comparisons.
Both pair arms use same input/cache/code/model and budget; historical full-pool/fresh results are context, not matched timing controls.

resources.invalid_own_cg_dependency: Cancel dependent MIP automatically (--kill-on-invalid-dep=yes); no change to valid or usable time-limited CG dependency.
